## Summary

Describe the testing behavior, example, or documentation change.

## Reviewer Focus

- [ ] The test protects meaningful behavior.
- [ ] Assertions and names are readable.
- [ ] Mocks are used only around useful boundaries.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant tests pass.
- [ ] Edge cases are covered when the behavior has boundaries.
- [ ] Documentation updated when the testing approach changed.

## Portfolio Signal

Explain what this PR makes stronger for a technical interview.
